slot_note: Architecture 2, a new world on assigned ground (survey-research-official-statistics / anomaly-detection), drawn under the pincer filed as stumping 1.2b: the decisive step is a quantity the records measure about their own production (case two), not a fact about how they were produced (cases one and three). Architecture 1, the pensions answer-time build, is spent at stage 4; see lineage. The rotation-group family was ruled out before design against task125 and the validation-subsample family against task192.
niche: the field interviewer workforce of a national statistics office's face-to-face household survey: which region's rise in a probed prevalence item is the population's own and which is carried by the handful of interviewers who collected it there

spine.entity: one sampled person's interview record in one quarter

world.org_type: a survey research institute running a national statistics office's continuous face-to-face household survey under contract

driver: A measured difference between places is produced by the few people who did the measuring there rather than by the places themselves, and because most measurers work one place only the measurer and the place are collinear, so holding the comparison to the measurer absorbs the place as well; the difference is attributed only through the minority of measurers whose workload crosses places, where the same measurer's own differential reproduces away from the place that looks worst.
driver_concrete: The rise in a region's probed prevalence item is read as the region's own, but a small region's quarter is collected by a handful of interviewers whose workloads the sample management log records, so the region that rises most is the one whose dominant interviewer carries a high differential, and only that interviewer's own records in the other regions she worked separate her differential from the region's population.
stump: A competent solver weights the person records to the design, reads every classification and filed rule correctly, ranks the regions on their quarter-on-quarter change in the probed prevalence item and files the region whose rise is largest, because that rise is a correct measurement of what its own interviewers collected and most of it is one interviewer's differential that reproduces in the other regions she worked.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who weights the microdata to the design, reads every classification correctly and applies every filed rule ranks the regions on their quarter-on-quarter change in the probed prevalence item and files the region whose rise is largest, because that rise is a correct measurement of what its interviewers collected.
domain_test: The quantity that decides is the interviewer component of a survey's measurement error, which survey research estimates from the random allocation of issued addresses among the interviewers working an area (the interpenetrated assignment behind every published interviewer design effect); swap the nouns to megawatt-hours or hospital visits and there is no workforce collecting the measurement, no allocation to randomise and no workload that crosses units, so nothing can make a measured difference travel with a person rather than a place.

differentiation.task107: task107's architecture 2, spent on the portal, shares the shape of a property of who handled each unit, but there the handler delivered an intervention and crossed from the treated arm into the comparison arm, so the quantity is a treatment effect scaled by receipt and the mechanism is contamination reached by joining a timetable to a staff directory to a certification register. Here nobody delivers anything: the interviewer records the respondent, the quantity is a prevalence difference between places with no arms and no intervention, and the identification is the recorder's portability, her own differential reproducing in the other places she worked.
differentiation.task192: task192's self-measuring quantity is a validation subsample's error rates and whether they transport outside the window they were measured in, so its decisive step is about the reach of a measurement already made. Mine is the interviewer component of the measurement itself, measured by the random allocation of addresses among the interviewers working an area, and the decisive step is attribution across units rather than transport across time.
differentiation.task194: task194's self-measuring quantity is two vintages of one series measuring their own coding lag, which is a property of when records arrive. Mine is a property of who collected them, and nothing in it turns on records arriving late or on a period being incomplete.
differentiation.task195: task195's self-measuring quantity is shared specimens making two screens' calls dependent, so its decisive step is the uncertainty of a paired difference. Mine moves a point estimate rather than an interval, and the paired structure is one measurer across places rather than two measurements of one unit.
differentiation.task125: task125 is the nearest build in this domain and it is why the rotation-group family was ruled out before design: it separates a fieldwork artifact from a real labour market move in a national household labour survey, where the artifact comes from what happens at the point units are recruited and builds through the waves a unit stays in. Mine carries no panel, no waves and no recruitment effect; the artifact is the identity of the interviewer and is identified across places in one quarter.

lineage.fate: spent at stage 4 on 2026-10-18: determinism judge NOT_DETERMINISTIC, SEND_BACK, underspecified_objective on Gates C and E with Gate H reading the decisive step as rule application, and the isolated leak reader reached the same finding independently. The pack itself passed every free gate (19 files, four formats, a 42,481-row spine, byte-identical rebuilds, pair ceiling 39.5, mirror leakage 12.0) and the world, the pack architecture and the Layer 1 mess are kept for architecture 2.
lineage.why: Framework clause 4.2 filed the comparison, a queue's share against its own earlier quarters 'which carried the same offered load', which was correct and mandatory because the comparison is one of the five parts of the WHAT. The residue left open was how closely 'the same' must match, which is a knob rather than a method: Contribution queries wins under the nearest one to four quarters pooled or a load band of 0.05 to 0.2, Investment switches (the plain highest-share answer) under a band of 0.22 to 0.3 or load rounded to whole positions-equivalents, and Member data corrections under five or more nearest quarters pooled or no matching. Pinning the tolerance closes C and E and finishes F, because with the comparison filed and the tolerance filed nothing analytical is left. The rule it earned is now in determinism-check section 1.
lineage.driver: The outcome a unit is judged on falls steeply with the number of parallel servers it runs at an unchanged load per server, so an expectation built on that ratio alone sits above every small unit and below every large one, and the unit whose outcome genuinely exceeds what its own load and server count imply sits mid-pack on any ratio-based residual while the smallest unit tops it.
lineage.driver_concrete: The share of member-service cases answered outside target that a queue's own offered load and staffed positions imply is read off the queue's own earlier quarters, and matching those quarters on the load divided by the staffed positions instead of on the load itself reads Member data corrections' five-position FY2026 quarters against the fourteen-position quarters it ran at the same occupancy while a remediation programme carried nearly three times the caseload, so it reports a 16.0 point gap there and only 10.2 for Contribution queries, whose load and roster never moved.
lineage.stump: A competent solver rebuilds every queue's FY2026 breach share correctly across both case systems on the financial year with the clock rules and the unanswered cases applied, compares each queue with its own FY2023 to FY2025 quarters at the same load per staffed position, and commits Member data corrections at 25.8 per cent, because that queue carried fourteen positions through the two years its own history is read from and five in FY2026.
lineage.answer: Contribution queries (MS-CQ) takes the one process re-engineering review in the first half of 2027; its FY2026 breach share is 12.4 per cent, on the 6,480 cases it received between 1 April 2025 and 31 March 2026.
lineage.world: Ireland, a third-party pensions administrator's nine member-service case queues
lineage.replaced_by: architecture 2 moves to a new world because the pensions pack cannot carry a different mechanism: every mechanism inside 'which of nine queues stands furthest above what its own conditions imply' is either the comparison, a convention the closure table must close, or architecture 1's own driver. Fourteen screened mechanisms are recorded in the design note.

notes: stump_strategy other: the decisive move is the attribution of a measured difference between units to the person who collected it rather than to the unit, identified by that person's portability across units. Not composition_mix (no stratum reweighting; the interviewer differentials are set orthogonal to everything that predicts the item, asserted near zero), not population_selection or maturity_censoring (both banned and both untrue here: the population is filed and complete and no period is open), not causal_design (banned; there is no intervention, no arms and no counterfactual), not uncertainty_hold (the decisive move shifts a point estimate, not an interval). Gate G decomposition_attribution is a WARN-level repeat only. G3 record versus operation is decisive: the region's record reflects who recorded it rather than the region's own population. Objective is fixed by the task number's lane block (task180 to task227), so overuse.objective cannot be varied; question form follows the decision, which is a pick of one region for one scarce follow-up.
layer1: a continuous survey whose quarterly person file changes layout at a questionnaire revision, so two layouts span the comparison period
face-to-face and telephone collection running side by side with different field periods inside the quarter
the sample management log held at issued-address grain while the person file is at person grain, with households resolving to several persons
interviewer identifiers recycled when field staff leave and are re-engaged, so one identifier covers two people across the series
a territorial authority amalgamation mid-series, so the published regional breakdown changes base
design weights and calibrated weights both present in the person file
management system stamps in UTC against New Zealand local time across a daylight saving change
the quarterly release carrying a provisional and a revised figure for the same quarter
